4. Issue notice.
The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
5. The petitioner and respondent no.2 are present before this Court and have been identified by their counsel and Investigating Officer (IO)

6. Brief facts of the case are that the petitioner and respondent no. 2 were in a relationship since 2020.

It is stated that over time, certain disputes and differences had arisen between the petitioner Najmul Hoda vs State Nct Of Delhi & Anr on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60078004/
1 and respondent no. 2 which could not be settled due to long distance between the parties as the petitioner was employed in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the respondent no. 2 was residing in Delhi.

sentences.text: Therefore, complaint made by respondent no. 2, the present FIR came to be registered against the petitioner.
It is stated that in the meantime, petitioner and respondent no. 2 had contracted marriage/Nikaah on 23.07.2025.

Further, it is stated that with intervention of the family and friends, the parties have now amicably settled their dispute vide Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) dated 11.08.2025.
7.

On a query made by this Court, respondent no. 2 who has been identified by the IO, has categorically stated that she has entered into compromise out of her own free will and without any pressure, coercion or threat.
Therefore, she has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.

8. In view of the above, since the parties have amicably resolved their differences out of their own free will, and without any coercion, no useful purpose will be served by continuing the proceedings

,
rather the same would create further acrimony between them.
It would thus be in interest of justice to quash the abovementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
There is no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.

9. Accordingly, FIR bearing no. 0170/2025, registered at Police Station Shaheen Bagh, Delhi for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 376/313 of IPC and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed, subject to respondent no.2 depositing a sum of Rs.
This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 05/09/2025 at 23:50:38 25,000/- with the Advocates Welfare Fund, Saket Court, within a period of seven days from date.

10. The petition stands disposed of.
11.
The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
